title: Chart-normalized ring data on enlarged etale sites
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $X,Y$ be algebraic spaces over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Write $\mathcal C_A$ for the category of chartwise etale algebraic spaces over $A$, with all arrows over $A$ and jointly surjective chartwise etale coverings [lem-trf-space-chartwise-etale-permanence], and $i_A:A_{\mathrm{et}}\to\mathcal C_A$ for the scheme inclusion [def-trf-scheme-algebraic-space]. For a sheaf of commutative rings $R$ on $\mathcal C_A$, define its ring sheaf by forgetting commutativity, and its lifted ring sheaf by applying the sectionwise $\operatorname{ULift}$ coefficient transport [def-pur-cochain-coefficient-universe-transport] and then forgetting commutativity; the latter has coefficient universe $\max(u+1,w)$ for $S$ in universe $u$ and arbitrary $w$. For $f:X\to Y$, let $f_*G(V)=G(X\times_YV)$, using the sheaf fibre products [lem-trf-space-fibre-products-etale-covers]. A morphism $\alpha:R_Y\to f_*R_X$ has an underlying lifted map by the same sectionwise transport and then forgetting to sets. Given specified ring-sheaf isomorphisms $e_A:i_A^*R_A\simeq\mathcal O_A$ for $A=X,Y$, define the chart-normalization predicate on $\alpha$ as follows: for every scheme object $U\to X$, every scheme object $V\to Y$ and every $S$-map $q:U\to V$ commuting with $f$, the composite $\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_V)\xrightarrow{e_Y^{-1}}R_Y(V)\xrightarrow{\alpha_V}R_X(X\times_YV)\to R_X(U)\xrightarrow{e_X}\Gamma(U,\mathcal O_U)$ is $q^*$, where the middle restriction is along the canonical map $U\to X\times_YV$.
